exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Choosing a School Club
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: Which school club are you going to join this term, Sam?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: I'm thinking about the Go Green Club. I care a lot about nature.

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: That sounds great. What do members usually do there?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: We organise events to reduce waste and teach children to recycle.

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: Nice! I want to join the Art Club myself.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Why the Art Club? Do you like drawing?

transcript.speaker: Tina
transcript.text: Yes, and I've heard you can learn design by making things with your hands.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: That's true. Learning by doing is the best way to remember.

exercises.translation_cn: Tina 问 Sam 这学期加入哪个社团;Sam 想加入环保社,因为关心大自然;社团组织活动减少浪费、教孩子回收;Tina 想加入美术社,因为喜欢画画,且听说能通过动手做来学设计;Sam 同意做中学最利于记忆。

questions.stem: Which club is Sam thinking about joining?
Why does Sam want that club?
options: He cares a lot about nature.

questions.stem: What do members of Sam's club do?
options: They organise events to reduce waste.

questions.stem: Why does Tina choose the Art Club?
options: Because she likes drawing and design.

questions.stem: What do they agree is the best way to remember?

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 Learning Is Everywhere
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: Learning is never limited to classrooms. It may happen at home, in a laboratory, or out in nature. Marie Curie learned a love of poetry from her father at home. Charles Darwin discovered the joy of science in a simple garden shed. Nelson Mandela learned important lessons while looking after sheep in the fields. Their stories remind us that real learning can take place anywhere, at any age.
exercises.translation_cn: 学习从不局限于教室。它可能发生在家里、实验室或大自然中。居里在家从父亲那里学会了热爱诗歌;达尔文在简陋的花园棚里发现了科学的乐趣;曼德拉在田野放羊时学到重要的人生课。他们的故事提醒我们,真正的学习可以发生在任何地方、任何年龄。

questions.stem: What is the main message of the passage?
Where did Curie learn to love poetry?
Where did Darwin find the joy of science?
What was Mandela doing when he learned his lessons?
What do the three stories remind us?
options: Real learning can happen anywhere and at any age.

exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Wu Xuan
transcript.text: I've been working on my English a lot recently.

transcript.speaker: Liu Xin
transcript.text: Really? Why so hard all of a sudden?

transcript.speaker: Wu Xuan

transcript.speaker: Liu Xin
transcript.text: I see. So that's why you look a little tired.

transcript.speaker: Wu Xuan

transcript.speaker: Liu Xin
transcript.text: What have you done to improve so much?

transcript.speaker: Wu Xuan
transcript.text: I've been listening to English radio every day to get used to the speed.

transcript.speaker: Liu Xin
transcript.text: Lucky you! Then you don't need to worry about the test.

exercises.translation_cn: 吴轩说最近一直在努力学英语;刘心问为何突然这么拼;因为下周这个时候要参加重要考试;所以看起来有点累;但他觉得自己进步很大;靠每天听英语广播来习惯语速;刘心说那就不用担心考试了。

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 Try Something New for 30 Days
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: Here is a simple idea for lifelong learners: try something new for thirty days. A month is just long enough to build a good habit or break a bad one. One man used this idea to hike up a high mountain and even to write a short book. He became more confident and adventurous. His advice is to keep your goals small and easy to keep, because small daily steps are what finally bring real change.
exercises.translation_cn: 给终身学习者一个简单的点子:坚持尝试新事物三十天。一个月刚好够养成一个好习惯或改掉一个坏习惯。有个人用这个方法登上高山,甚至写了一本短书。他变得更自信、更爱冒险。他的建议是把目标定得小而易于坚持,因为正是每天的小步带来真正的改变。

questions.stem: What is the simple idea in the passage?
options: Try something new for thirty days.

questions.stem: Why is a month long enough?
options: It is the longest time possible.
It can help build a habit or break one.

questions.stem: What did one man do with this idea?
options: He hiked a mountain and wrote a short book.

questions.stem: How did the man change?
options: He became more confident and adventurous.

questions.stem: What is the man's advice?
options: Set the biggest goals you can.
Keep goals small and easy to keep.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Advice on Time Management
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: I never seem to have enough time for my studies. Any advice?

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Try making a clear plan for each day before you start.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Does that really help?

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Yes. It helps you see what matters most and do it first.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: That makes sense. What else can I do?

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Take short breaks, so your mind stays fresh and active.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: I'll try that. I always feel tired after studying for hours.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Little by little, you'll learn to use your time well.

exercises.translation_cn: Ben 说学习时间总是不够,求建议;Mia 建议开始前为每天做清晰计划;能帮你看清最重要的事并先做;还建议休息片刻,让头脑保持清醒活跃;Ben 说连学几小时后总是很累;Mia 说慢慢就会学会善用时间。

questions.stem: What is Ben's problem?
options: He never has enough time for studies.

questions.stem: What is Mia's first piece of advice?
How does a plan help, according to Mia?
options: It helps you do the most important things first.

questions.stem: What is Mia's second piece of advice?
options: Take short breaks to stay fresh.

questions.stem: What will happen little by little?
options: Ben will learn to use his time well.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 The Value of Learning by Doing
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: Many great thinkers believed that we learn best by doing. Xunzi, an ancient Chinese teacher, said that learning should never stop and that true success comes from never giving up. Modern teachers agree. When students fold paper, build towers or grow plants, they remember far more than from books alone. Each small mistake teaches them something new. So the next time you face a hard task, do not just read about it. Try it with your own hands, and learn.
exercises.translation_cn: 许多伟大的思想家都相信我们在动手中学得最好。古代中国老师荀子说,学习不应停止,真正的成功来自永不放弃。现代教师也认同。当学生折纸、搭塔或种植物时,他们记住的远比只看书多。每一个小错误都教会他们新东西。所以下次面对难题时,别只是读它,用你自己的双手去尝试、去学习。

questions.stem: What did many great thinkers believe?
What did Xunzi say about learning?
options: It is only for the young.
It is a waste of time.

questions.stem: What helps students remember more?
What does each small mistake do?
What does the speaker suggest doing with a hard task?
options: Ask someone else to do it.
Try it with your own hands.
